# Estate360

> Estate360 is a CRM for Indian real-estate sales teams. It turns enquiries, WhatsApp conversations, site visits, inventory, bookings and collections into one daily workflow, and tells the team what to do next.

Estate360 is built by Estate360 Technologies Pvt. Ltd. in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It is a multi-tenant CRM: each customer gets an isolated workspace, and every query is scoped to it.

Key facts:

- Pricing starts at ₹1,499 per month. Plans are listed at http://localhost:3000/pricing.
- Free trial: 14 days, no card required.
- Languages: English, Gujarati, Hindi.
- Compliance: RERA registration numbers carried on generated documents; DPDP Act 2023 privacy policy.
- Contact: hello@estate360.in · +91 79 4890 2200

## Pages

- [Real Estate CRM for Indian Sales Teams](http://localhost:3000/): : One CRM for enquiries, WhatsApp, site visits, inventory, bookings and collections. Built for Indian builders and sales teams. Start free, no card.
- [Product](http://localhost:3000/product): : Inventory, cost sheets, CLP milestones, GPS site visits, broker scoping, RERA documents and a WhatsApp inbox in Gujarati, Hindi and English.
- [Pricing](http://localhost:3000/pricing): : Straightforward pricing for Indian real-estate teams. Every plan includes RERA documents, CLP demand letters, GPS site visits and WhatsApp.
- [Contact](http://localhost:3000/contact): : Questions about Estate360, pricing, or a pilot for your sales team? Reach us on WhatsApp, email, or phone. We reply within one working day.
- [Privacy Policy](http://localhost:3000/privacy): : How Estate360 collects, uses, stores and deletes personal data, including DPDP Act 2023 rights and where your data is stored.
- [Terms of Service](http://localhost:3000/terms): : The terms governing your use of Estate360, including acceptable use, data ownership, subscriptions, and termination.
- [Estate360 vs Excel vs Generic CRMs](http://localhost:3000/compare): : Honest comparisons for Indian real-estate teams deciding between Excel, a generic CRM, and a builder-first CRM like Estate360.
- [Estate360 vs Excel + WhatsApp for Builders](http://localhost:3000/compare/excel): : Where an Excel inventory and WhatsApp groups stop working for a sales team: audit trail, broker scoping, GPS site visits, and CLP collections.
- [Estate360 vs a Generic CRM for Real Estate](http://localhost:3000/compare/generic-crm): : Generic CRMs model contacts and deals; Estate360 models units, cost sheets, CLP milestones and RERA documents — built for Indian residential sales.
- [Start Free](http://localhost:3000/signup): : Create your workspace and start tracking leads, inventory and bookings. Fourteen days free, no card required, export your data any time.
